Overview - Piers Ridyard, CEO

As you can imagine, as we start to run up to the Alphanet launch of the Babylon network, the tech team is getting very, very busy. So busy, in fact that this week’s updates are almost entirely pictorial. Bonus points for anyone who can decipher precisely what is going on.

Even if you cannot understand the pictures, be assured that some fantastic engineering is being done by a team soaked in the fire of product delivery in the DLT space, and operating at peak “get-shit-done” performance mode.

August is normally a slow month otherwise, but not for the RDX Works tech team - this is where we start to build the power that will see us through Alphanet, Betanet, and beyond.

It sounds like the growling of distant thunder. Cannot wait to share it with the world.

‍

Strategy & Marketing (Adam Simmons, CSO & Jeremy Epstein, CMO) 

Short update today as most of the recent news is in Marketing Wen-sday Shard #6, published last week, so take a look in there. Bonus points if you find a typo. Since then, however, we had a nice article in VentureBeat, written by Piers, Starting your development journey into the world of Web3, which got some nice pickup in other outlets like Business Insider.

Plus, the community continues to rock it out with events. We had a nice turnout in Oslo and Cape Town on August 4th, and next week, there’s an event in Portland, Oregon, USA.

‍

‍

Development (Russell Harvey, CTO & Matthew Hine, CPO)

‍

Update from the Radix Community

Thank you to those who submitted their ELI5 on Radix last week! There were so many great submissions, with diverse approaches to explaining Radix in simple, easy-to-understand terms. You people Rock!

Ok, let’s cut to the chase and announce the winners! A jury of 5 people from the Radix Community Council voted on all submissions, and the highest points were given to the following participants: 

  1. The winner of 1500 XRD: @Cryptonoval

  2. The winner of 1000 XRD: @Markalmond

  3. The winner of 500 XRD: @Nellysayon

Please send a DM to @denizdenizdenize to receive your prizes! 

The Radix community is gearing up for the Blockchain Expo on 20-21 September 2022 in Rai, Amsterdam! Seven thousand attendees are expected to congregate from across Europe, including CTOs, Heads of Innovation and Technology, IT Directors, Developers, Start-Ups, OEMs, Government, Automotive, Operators, Technology Providers, Investors, VCs, and many more.

*If you are a developer and/or a project lead, please feel free to join us at the event and help us tell Radix’s journey and revolutionary solutions to people from all over the world! If you are interested in participating, please shoot a DM to @Stefanpersson or @denizdenizdenize!

‍

*Updates provided directly by members of the Radix community.
